# Mengizinkan semua crawler umum untuk merayap situs kecuali halaman privat
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /dashboard
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /mitra-dashboard
Disallow: /agent-dashboard
Disallow: /profile
Disallow: /my-bookings
Disallow: /payment-status/
Disallow: /payment-callback
